_note: MVP world. Leagues are data-driven: adding a country later means adding entries here, not code. Dates are templates for season Y/Y+1; the scheduler places matches on weekend and midweek slots between these bounds.
_tieBreakersNote: Each league lists its own table tie-breakers, applied in order (T, 2026-10-14). Allowed: points, goalDifference, goalsFor, goalsAgainst, wins, headToHeadPoints, headToHeadGoalDifference, headToHeadGoalsFor, draw. draw is a seeded random draw and must come last.

leagues.name: English second tier

playoff.eliminators: single match: 5th hosts 8th, 6th hosts 7th; extra time and penalties if level
playoff.semis: two-legged: 3rd vs lowest-seeded eliminator winner, 4th vs highest-seeded eliminator winner; higher seed hosts the second leg; extra time and penalties after the second leg
playoff.final: single match at a neutral venue, extra time and penalties

schedule.eliminators: first midweek slot after the final league round
schedule._finalNote: Final on the weekend slot nearest 05-24 (around 23-25 May).

playoff._source: Mirrors the real 2026/27 EFL format (expanded from 4 to 6 clubs).

leagues._relegationNote: Lowest simulated tier: no relegation in the MVP.

leagues.name: German top flight
leagues._relegationNote: Only simulated German tier in the MVP: no relegation until a German second tier exists.
leagues._boardNote: Lowest board target is 'finish above the bottom 3' (instead of 'avoid relegation') while GER1 has no relegation.

cups.name: English cup
cups.format: single-leg knockout, extra time and penalties if level, random draw each round

cups.name: German cup
cups.format: single-leg knockout, extra time and penalties if level; 18 clubs, so the 4 lowest-placed clubs from last season play a preliminary round to reach 16

preliminary.selection: lowest finish in last season's GER1 table
preliminary.firstSeasonSelection: lowest strength in clubs_2026_27.json (no previous table)

renewals._note: Renewals (user and AI) only inside the windows; no end-of-season re-sign phase. A contract ending 06-30 must be renewed by the winter deadline (01-31), or the player leaves as a free agent on 07-01. Inbox: a warning when the winter window opens listing every player in his final expiryWarningMonths, and a reminder before deadline day.

matchSlots: Two per week: weekend (Sat) and midweek (Wed). League rounds take weekend slots; extra league rounds and cup ties take midweek slots. Germany plays no matches during its winter break; England plays through it.

rosterRules._minSeniorForMatchNote: If fewer than minSeniorForMatch seniors are fit, academy players aged academyMatchdayMinAge+ fill the bench.
